errors.text_span: 分别代表体育、社会、榜样、政治、文化和经济六个类别
errors.evidence: There are seven distinct categories present in the pie chart, not six.
The colors and percentages assigned to the categories are incorrect; the categories and their corresponding values do not align correctly.
The description does not clearly state the overall purpose of the pie chart.
The description omits mention of the two slices that are both labeled as 2% (and are visually emphasized together), which are incorrectly interpreted in the description.
